newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK govt concerned about property anxieties - Patten.
newsitem.headline: HK govt concerned about property anxieties - Patten.

text.p: Hong Kong Governor Chris Patten said on Wednesday the government was concerned about anxieties being expressed that a new bout of speculation is hitting the property market.

"We are keeping the situation under urgent review, and I mean urgent...and if there does appear to be unacceptable speculation producing a bubble in the market, we won't hesitate to take whatever action may be necessary," he told reporters.
The government's anti-speculation measures had been successful in the past, he noted.
Patten said the only long-term solution to curb speculation was to increase the supply of flats, which the administration had been doing.
